Our story

How we got here

  1. 2019

    The first hello

    A friend’s wedding in Delhi, a shared plate of chaat, and a conversation that didn’t end.

  2. 2021

    The first trip

    Udaipur in the rain. One camera, two very bad photos, and the first “I love you”.

  3. 2025

    The proposal

    On a rooftop in Jaipur, with a ring hidden in a box of ladoos. She found it. She said yes.

  4. 2027

    The wedding

    Three days, both families, and the beginning of everything else.
